title: Record the 2026-10-26/28 operator decisions and align program docs
body:
The coherence audit of 2026-10-28 found operator decisions recorded only in lead memory and task notes (Paperclip never a fallback; Beads only project-wise, carrying the ADR 0011 rejection; lesson-page enforcement retired under D14; host policy moves into GLOBAL; krn task comments as a D23 exception) and program docs that contradict ADR 0014/0015 (panel roles, krn ship merge path, task-claims directory, stale PLAN items, JSONL wording).
Acceptance: ADR 0014 records the decisions with verbatim quotes, and repository-workflow.md, README.md, CONTEXT.md and PLAN.md agree with ADR 0014/0015 and the shipped CLI; no historical project data changes.
